gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 round-S3 Killing zero-mode measure quotient normalization audit
scope: For the parent-certified spatial FP operator on round S3, audit only the six l=1 transverse Killing zero modes removed by the primed determinant. Compute their L2 Gram matrix from an explicit embedding-space Killing basis, derive the induced collective-coordinate Jacobian scaling, and determine whether the absolute residual SO(4) gauge-group-volume normalization is fixed by the frozen field-space inner product alone. Do not assign a signed FP phase, do not touch the TT Hessian, and do not claim a complete one-loop measure if an independent Haar/group-volume convention remains necessary.

frozen_background.spatial_manifold: round S3 embedded as x_A x_A=a^2 in R4

frozen_zero_mode_basis.sphere_moment: integral_S3 sqrt(g) x_A x_B=(a^2/4) Vol(S3) delta_AB

required_checks: Derive the six-by-six Gram matrix from the frozen embedding Killing basis and the S3 second moment; do not insert a numerical group volume by convention.
Verify all six basis generators are mutually orthogonal in the ordered A<B basis and have equal positive norm squared pi^2*a^5.
Verify sqrt(det Gram)=pi^6*a^15 for this basis and field-space inner product.
Construct the corresponding orthonormal zero-mode basis Khat_AB=K_AB/(pi*a^(5/2)).
Separate the induced zero-mode/collective-coordinate Jacobian from the dimensionless Haar coordinate volume of the residual SO(4) orbit.

Test invariance under reciprocal basis/coordinate rescaling K_AB->c K_AB, theta_AB->theta_AB/c and demonstrate that an absolute group-volume number requires a convention for Haar-coordinate normalization/global quotient rather than following from the local FP spectrum alone.
Do not assign a signed or complex FP phase, do not multiply by the prior FS determinant, and do not evaluate the TT Hessian.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter coefficients, change thresholds, allow soft-s retest, unblock k=0.03 production, or mix DSIR.
pass_condition: The exact Killing Gram matrix, its determinant/Jacobian scaling, and an orthonormal zero-mode basis are derived consistently, while any independent Haar/global residual-isometry volume convention is explicitly left open rather than guessed. This is a scoped zero-mode-measure result only.
fail_condition: The explicit S3 Gram identities fail, the six-dimensional zero-mode count changes, basis-rescaling consistency fails, or the audit claims a unique absolute SO(4) volume without a separately frozen Haar/global normalization convention.
